label: q1-json
sql:
SELECT truck_id,
       count(*)                     AS pings,
       max(speed_kmh)               AS max_kmh,
       round(avg(speed_kmh), 1)     AS avg_kmh,
       count_if(speed_kmh > 80) * 5 AS seconds_over_80
FROM mvela_fleet.raw_pings_json
WHERE event_ms >= 1791331200000 AND event_ms < 1791417600000
GROUP BY truck_id
ORDER BY truck_id
